china_race_dynamics.text:
U.S. universities produce ~700k STEM graduates per year.  

We need to fill 3.5 million STEM jobs by next year. 

To compete with Communist China, we desperately need to fill this gap. 

Should we update our immigration system to help us win in the AI & Cyber race?

CC @elonmusk https://t.co/dL8roLVBnY

deepseek.reason: She says the US desperately needs to fill STEM jobs to compete with China and asks about immigration changes to win the AI and cyber race.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly frames competing with China and winning the AI/cyber race as a priority.
